title: Mystic Crystal Ball Oracle
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a metallic pedestal atop a wooden surface. Inside the sphere, a dark silhouetted figure stands amid green slime, palm trees, and dripping goo, with a large yellow cat-like eye and toothy grin floating above. Swirling purple and orange smoke with a demonic face emerges from the top against a dark mountainous backdrop.
prompt: A large glowing crystal ball on a metallic stand, viewed at night. Inside the transparent sphere is a dark humanoid silhouette standing in glowing green slime with small palm trees. A giant yellow slit-pupil eye and wide white grin float above the figure. Bright blue energy lines radiate from the center. Swirling purple, pink, and orange ethereal smoke with a demonic skull-like face emerges from the top of the orb. Dark purple mountains in the background, dramatic neon lighting, surreal fantasy style.
